title: Field Lab Chronicle & Risk Clipboard
body:
Purpose:
Capture a condensed runbook + decision ledger from the Field Lab (Week-of) for the Acme POC. This doc is intentionally operational — use it at standups, during workshops, and hand to SRE/devs during the hot window.

Scope / quick summary:
- Objective: Validate Redwood Private deployed in Acme staging VPC, guarantee 99th pct latency SLO for chat endpoint under a 1k QPS peak burst, and surface model-quality and cost tradeoffs for their data distribution.
- Timebox: 4-week lab (baseline week + 3x sprint weeks) with an agreed target for demo at the end of Week 4.
- Deliverables: deployment runbook, latency/cost baseline report, canary rollback policy, acceptance checklist, handoff notes.

Runbook - high level steps (operational checklist):
1) Pre-lab prep (owner: Maya) — complete by Day -3
   - Provisiondedicated cluster in us-west-2 (k8s+NVIDIA A100-40GB nodes) — cluster id: CL-ACME-07 (Jira: JIRA-ENG-9812).
   - Bake model variants: redwood-3b-fp16, redwood-3b-8bit, redwood-7b-q4_0. Build docker images and push to registry.
   - Confirm KMS keys and log ingestion (ELK) with security; ensure that audit logs are flowing to Acme SIEM endpoint.
   - Upload baseline prompt set (acme-baseline-v1) to /confluence/ACME/prompt-sets (Confluence ref above).

2) Day 0 - Lab kickoff & infra smoke (owner: Ethan)
   - Run synthetic traffic generator (seq-latency-tool) at 50 RPS to validate cold-start path + streaming. Check KV cache warmup.
   - Run ingestion to observe CPU/GPU temp, mem pressure; set conservative autoscale policy to 3->12 pods.

3) Sprint cadence (Weeks 1-3) - goals per week:
   - Week 1: Baseline & profiling (latency p50/p95/p99, token cost/op) — focused on model-variant comparison.
   - Week 2: Optimization experiments (batching config, KV cache TTL, early-exit beam changes, 8-bit quantization validation).
   - Week 3: Hardening & rollout (canary configs, failure drills, rollback rehearsals, telemetry retention tweaks).

Timeline (compact):
- Week 0 (prep): 2025-07-14 -> 2025-07-20: infra provision + model bake + prompt set import.
- Week 1: 2025-07-21 -> 2025-07-27: baseline experiments; identify top-2 candidate configs.
- Week 2: 2025-07-28 -> 2025-08-03: apply optimization profiles; track quality regression metrics.
- Week 3: 2025-08-04 -> 2025-08-10: canary rollouts; SLA tests; failure injection.
- Demo day: 2025-08-12: stakeholder demo and decision-to-proceed meeting.

Task tracker (short form, use for daily standup):
- Maya: finalize cluster sizing + cost estimate (DUE: 2025-07-16) - TODO
- Ethan: synthetic workload harness and traffic shapes (DUE: 2025-07-18) - DONE
- Priya: telemetry dashboards (p50/p95/p99, cost per 1k tokens) (DUE: 2025-07-20) - IN PROGRESS
- Jonas: security checklist + KMS handover (DUE: 2025-07-19) - IN PROGRESS
- SRE oncall: confirm autoscaler policy + eviction tolerances (DUE: 2025-07-20) - TODO

Risk register (live):
- R1: Model quality regression after quantization — Impact: High, Prob: Medium
  Mitigation: keep fp16 variant as fallback; automated eval suite after each build; acceptance gate requiring no >2% drop on core metrics.
- R2: Latency SLO breaches under burst QPS — Impact: High, Prob: High
  Mitigation: conservative autoscale sizing, pre-warmed cache, synthetic spike soak test, fallback to hosted API during surge.
- R3: Logging/PII leakage risk in prompts — Impact: Critical, Prob: Low
  Mitigation: scrub pipeline, toggle PII redaction middleware in front of calls, security signoff pre-demo.
- R4: Region capacity constraint for GPUs — Impact: Medium, Prob: Medium
  Mitigation: have plan to move to us-east region w/ VLAN peering; dry-run transfer of registry access.

Decision ledger (append-only, short entries):
- 2025-07-15: Decided to prioritize redwood-3b-8bit as cost baseline. (Maya)
- 2025-07-18: Agreed to enable prefix KV caching by default in canary. (Ethan/Priya)
- 2025-07-20: Rollback window set to 15min for canary traffic; automated rollback on error rate >2%. (SRE)

Workshop notes (raw):
- Customer cares mostly about 1) predictable latency under bursts, 2) deterministic per-conversation cost.
- They accepted ~2% quality delta if cost savings >30% (note: capture exact wording in demo slide).
- Their infra team requested offline training on quantization tradeoffs — schedule after Week 2 demo.

Acceptance criteria (must pass before demo):
- Latency: p99 < 350ms for 95% of test slices (synthetic + recorded traffic).
- Quality: core eval drop <= 2% vs fp16 baseline on acme-baseline-v1 prompt set.
- Cost: per-conversation cost reduced by >= 25% under target traffic shape OR clear tradeoff plan documented.
- Security: KMS / audit logs validated, PII redaction demoed.

Playbooks & fallbacks (short):
- Canary failure: immediate rollback to previous image + scale to baseline instance count + notify customer slack channel (#acme-poc).
- Hot CPU/GPU: throttle concurrent requests at the loadbalancer layer and switch to hosted fallback pool for non-sensitive traffic.
- Data drift surprise: freeze model changes; run extended eval; escalate to product for acceptance.

Monitoring and dashboards (owners):
- Telemetry (Priya) - Live dashboard: p50/p95/p99, token/sec, queue depth, evictions, errors/1k responses.
- Cost (Maya) - Cost per 1k tokens + projected monthly burn at observed QPS.
- Quality (Ethan) - Regression alerts tied to the eval suite; slack hook for failures.

Open questions / outstanding items (tracked, action owners):
- Q1: Which exact prompt examples does Acme consider "corner cases"? (ask product) - Owner: Maya
- Q2: Validate whether Acme legal needs a separate DPA for telemetry exports. - Owner: Jonas
- Q3: Confirm if hosted fallback is allowed for PII-containing prompts. - Owner: Priya

Notes-to-self / workshop friction points to monitor:
- Keep the demo simple: show 2 model configs and cost delta + a single canary flip. Avoid showing 8 permutations of quant+batch combos.
- Bring a one-slide incident playbook for the demo (who calls, who rolls back, how long).
- Prepare a screenshot-based runbook for Acme infra (step-by-step login, kube context, how to trigger synthetic spike).

Appendix (links and artifacts):
- Confluence runbook draft: CONFLUENCE-ENG-4521
- Jira epic / tasks: JIRA-ENG-9812
- Container images: registry.redwood/acl/field-lab/ (internal)
- Quick demo checklist (print for demo table): Power, network, demo script, fallback creds, metrics tablet.

If you edit: please add a single-line changelog entry at the bottom with date and initials.

-- Maya
